src/kai_code/tasks/.description: Tasks module contains TaskManager singleton, Task/BackgroundShellTask/BackgroundAgentTask dataclasses, Rich panel UI, and LangChain tools. Uses threading for background execution with MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS=5 limit and callback system for task completion.

src/kai_code/tasks/task.py.description: Python dataclass inheritance automatically propagates parent fields to child classes. BackgroundShellTask and BackgroundAgentTask inherit priority field from Task without needing explicit redefinition.

src/kai_code/tasks/manager.py.description: TaskManager now has _pending_queue (PriorityTaskQueue), _available_slots() returns MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS - running count, and _process_queue() dequeues highest-priority tasks and starts them when slots available. Queue processing uses closure with default arg (t: Task = task) to capture task reference correctly in loop.
